_doc: Opt-in 820 reading diagnostic (R-tablet-reading-baseline). It stays out of rsi/runtime/ux/journeys.json because the default gate now owns this surface as J16 (820x1180 touch, the same long-table answer and incoming-activity legs); when this file was written its RED recorded the four Open gap-log findings of 2026-11-21. The coherent reading fix landed in #542, so this file is no longer the thing the gate waits on — it remains the focused diagnostic with the 1100 same-metric reference. It boots the same throwaway daemon and fake agent through scripts/journeys-smoke.sh --spec. The answer is the fake's `[seed] reading` branch: a long prose answer with a 5-row markdown table. The new-activity state is produced by sending a `[seed] slow` follow-up, scrolling back to the top while it is held, and then letting the reply land out of sight. `reading` observes only: metrics go to <out>/*.reading.json and the shared verdict names each criterion separately. 390 is not a reference: its header is MobileHeader (a different control set), so the desktop action-cluster metric does not apply there; 1100 is walked as the same-metric reference.
